summary: Full end-to-end testing of Saishruti Enterprises single-page site. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (root, contact create success, invalid email 422, missing fields 422, empty name 422, list returns array, list sorted desc). Frontend: all sections render, nav links smooth-scroll to all 5 sections, Hero + headline + CTAs + stats (05/120+/03), 5 service rows, 7 portfolio cards, marquee section present, testimonials prev/next rotate quotes, footer shows Mumbai/Surat/Guwahati, contact form empty-submit shows error toast, full submission persists to DB and shows success toast with form reset. No console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo then converts back on read; works fine but storing as native datetime would be cleaner for sort correctness across timezones
GET /api/contact has no auth — acceptable per spec (no auth required) but should be noted if site goes public
Contact form does client-side required check but does not surface field-level errors; current toast UX is fine for MVP
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed contact inquiries via API and one TEST_UIUser inquiry via UI form. These remain in the contact_inquiries collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers root, POST /api/contact (success + 422 validation cases) and GET /api/contact (list + sort). Frontend public URL is https://space-canvas-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Marquee testid is 'marquee-section' (not 'marquee'). shadcn Select for project-type works via clicking trigger then option testid contact-option-<slug>. Sonner toasts use [data-sonner-toast][data-type=success|error].
